<reason>B won the co-ownership clash: identifier must cross before consent, push is not passive posting, and pseudonymity cannot survive cross-platform lookup. That forced A to shrink to handles-only one-click convenience, which B then outweighed against standardized disclosure, giant-absorption, and all-platforms scope, while also answering A's lock-in pressure with a non-mandate alternative.</reason>
